{{Quote|Something happened somewhere.''"<br />"''Not from above. If it had come from above, we'd see the effects.|Han Solo converses with the Gotal|<ref name="TNR" />}}
In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Rebellion]]'' to [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].</ref> a '''Gotal''' was present in the [[Crystal Jewel]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], when an [[Bombing of the Senate Hall|explosion]] occurred nearby. The shockwave damaged the casino, and, believing it signified an attack on the capital, many of the casino's patrons fled the premises. Directly ahead of this [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] was [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[General/Legends|general]], who stopped suddenly outside of the casino, causing the Gotal to collide with him from behind. The Gotal shoved Solo, but then realized why the [[Human/Legends|Human]] had stopped: The skies of Coruscant were clear, indicating no assault had occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The Gotal exchanged words with Solo and [[Unidentified Crystal Jewel patron|another patron]] over the possible location of the explosion, with the Gotal excluding anywhere above them as the source; in actuality, the explosion had occurred in the nearby [[Senate Hall]].<ref name="TNR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gotal patron appeared in the [[1996]] novel ''[[The New Rebellion]]'', which was written by [[Kristine Kathryn Rusch]].<ref name="TNR" />
